role: Relative size and edge-definition audit; not an absolute physical-boundary certificate
inputs: Original9SEM images and Raw optical exposure13; archive optical centers initialize search windows only
scale_estimator: Median optical adjacent-center distance / median nativeSEM adjacent-center distance, independent of neural outputs and pillar radii
SEM_center: Native bright-rim Hough initialization followed by720-ray first-harmonic center refinement
SEM_boundary: Bright rim maximum; inner/outer half-height around the same rim are a definition-sensitivity band, not a statistical confidence interval
size_comparison: Equivalent diameter from enclosed radial area divided by center pitch; no resizing or optical-grid segmentation ofSEM
optical_boundary: Per-ray half-contrast with Raw-derived centers and plateaus frozen across models; no per-model rescaling or fitting
scale_bar: Inspect all original footers; metadata DPI is display metadata and must not be treated as physical pixel size
old_references: Retained unchanged for historical replay; do not require two differently-scaled references to be equally valid physical rulers
